initialExam.title: GATE Mechanical Engineering 2027
initialExam.description: GATE ME for M.Tech admissions and PSU recruitment in mechanical engineering. Highest number of candidates among GATE papers.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
initialExam.syllabus: Engineering Mathematics, Applied Mechanics, Material Science, Fluid Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Machine Design.
initialExam.jobRole: M.Tech in IITs/NITs, Engineer in BHEL/IOCL/NTPC/SAIL/ONGC
initialExam.careerGrowth: Through M.Tech or PSU career progression.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit GATE website 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: PSU benefits including DA, HRA, Medical
